headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.89
summary: The client menu GL overlay (ClientModBridge) no longer attaches when the mod menu is disabled and no native mods are loaded.

items.text: ClientModBridge no longer attaches its full-screen GLES3JNIView overlay, loads extra libraries or scans the game APK dex on sessions where the mod menu is disabled and no native mods are loaded.
